title: Waiting & Arrival Distributions
approval: Self-reviewed under the user's explicit authorization for the legacy redesign batch.
refinements: Use shared immediate radio feedback rather than the mockup's redundant Submit answer button.
Derive all probabilities and bar geometry from full-precision engine outputs; image geometry is illustrative.
Expected count is exact under the tick model and shared with the Poisson approximation, not exclusively Poisson.
Stack chart and estimate columns below 700px of workbench width; keep explicit model labels and a single rail Guide CTA.
Keep the timeline optional and seeded, with complete event seconds as its accessible data equivalent.
Normalize rendered CSS percentages to six significant digits for stable hydration; engine probabilities remain full precision, including tiny positive pooled tails.
